svg.aria-label: Supporters gave more than $1 million to a mother who murdered her three children and $42,000 to a woman burned saving six children
svg.title: Supporters gave more than $1 million to a mother who murdered her three children and $42,000 to a woman burned saving six children
svg.text: MONEY GIVEN BY SUPPORTERS, UNITED STATES, 2026
a mother who murdered her three children
a man who murdered a white teenager

g.title: More than half a million dollars

svg.text: a woman burned over 93% saving six children from a fire
The platform's rule against raising money for someone charged with a crime kept the killer of the teenager off it.
The rule was waived for the mother.
